name: Arathi Basin Resources!
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 2,750 experience instead of 3,300, 0.83 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you.  They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!

That is why Arathi Basin is important.  There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources.  Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.

That is what I want from you, adventurer.  Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a crate of resources.
narrative.objectives: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
narrative.offerRewardText: You got the resources! Great job! I'll send the resources to our quartermasters, who can quickly disperse them to our troops.Thank you, adventurer. Indeed, performing successful missions like the one you achieved are how wars are truly won.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the resource crate, adventurer? The League of Arathor can't fight a decent battle without them...
